speaker: npc
text:
A broad-shouldered man, meticulously uniformed with a weathered ledger case never far from his hand. A pale scar crosses his left eyebrow. His manner is formal, controlled, and he looks at you with an eye that seems to miss little. He speaks with quiet authority. 

What do you wish to discuss with me?

speaker: player
text: I've heard a caravan went missing and the watch has asked me to look into it

speaker: npc
text: Missing, you say? Precise details are needed, not hearsay. Which caravan specifically, and what was its last known position? This matter falls under my responsibility, so any information you have will be formally recorded. Who sent you, by the way?

speaker: player
text: The one that was going south. I'm interested to know if there is a reward for finding it. I am an adventurer. Are there any other opportunities for an adventurer like me to make some coin here?

speaker: player
text: The one that was going south. I'm interested to know if there is a reward for finding it. I am an adventurer. Are there any other opportunities for an adventurer like me to make some coin here?

speaker: npc
text:
The caravan bound for the south... yes. Its disappearance is a matter of official concern. Regarding a reward, specific terms are typically set by the merchant guild involved, though my office corroborates the information.

As for other opportunities, the road to the west has become... unpredictable. Competent security details are always in demand by the caravans, provided you are properly vetted. Is there a particular type of work you are accustomed to?

speaker: player
text: Fighting the bad guys... Any idea what that missing caravan was hauling?

speaker: npc
text:
The manifest indicated standard goods—textiles, some grain, nothing immediately volatile. If you intend to investigate, however, I suggest you speak with the guild master down near the market; they will have the most detailed inventory.

And should you find anything, bring your findings directly to me. Do not disseminate information to the public. Understood?

speaker: player
text: What is the name of the guild and the guild master?

speaker: npc
text: The organization is the Trade Nexus. The current guild master is named Harlen Thorne. You will find their offices positioned adjacent to the main market plaza. Do you require anything further regarding this matter?
